mechanics: Throw the Net and make a Martial Check contested by the target’s Physical Save. It has no effect on formless creatures or creatures smaller than Small or larger than Large. Save Failure: Immobilized until freed. Save Failure (5): also Restrained until freed. Forced movement doesn’t free the target, but teleportation does. A creature can spend 1 AP to make a DC 10 Athletics or Acrobatics Check to free itself or another creature within reach. A Medium creature throws it up to twice its Might in Spaces; Small creatures throw it half as far, and vertical distance is halved.
name: Net
summary: Contest Physical Save to Immobilize; Save Failure (5) also Restrains
